landmarks.title: Tick Tock
landmarks.name: Big Ben
landmarks.rule: Cross the full Westminster Bridge beside Big Ben on foot, by bicycle or by road.

landmarks.title: Paris is lovely this time of year
landmarks.name: Blackpool Tower
landmarks.rule: Cover the full Tower-front Promenade stretch, between the mapped north and south endpoints (about 250 m), on foot, by bicycle or by road.

landmarks.title: No longer the longest
landmarks.name: Humber Bridge
landmarks.rule: Cross the full Humber Bridge on foot, by bicycle or by road.

landmarks.title: Football or Cricket, Sir?
landmarks.name: Trent Bridge
landmarks.rule: Cross the full A60 Trent Bridge on foot, by bicycle or by road. Nottingham’s football and cricket grounds are nearby.

landmarks.title: Mooooo!
landmarks.name: Bullring Bull
landmarks.rule: Walk through the immediate pedestrian area around the Bullring Bull; nearby streets and New Street station do not count.

landmarks.title: The Far East
landmarks.name: Ness Point
landmarks.rule: Reach the Euroscope viewpoint at Ness Point on foot or by bicycle. Nearby Lowestoft routes do not count.

landmarks.title: Royal drive-by
landmarks.name: Windsor Castle
landmarks.rule: Drive or take a bus along the full defined M4 stretch north of Windsor, from the J6 area towards Datchet (about 3 km).

landmarks.title: Why hello Nessie
landmarks.name: Loch Ness
landmarks.rule: Cover at least 5 km of distinct lakeside A82, B852 or B862 road in one journey, within 300 m of the mapped Loch Ness shore. Repeated stretches count once.

landmarks.title: The Iron Ring
landmarks.name: Conwy Castle
landmarks.rule: Walk through the immediate castle area, or cross the full adjacent A547 road bridge on foot, by bicycle or by road. The railway and A55 do not count.

landmarks.title: Weather warning, Storms likely
landmarks.name: Stormont
landmarks.rule: Reach the grounds immediately around the Parliament Buildings at Stormont. The estate entrance and distant approach do not count.
